meta.title: Automation Engineer
meta.tagline: Design automated systems that improve efficiency and reduce human error.
meta.description: Automation engineers design, program and maintain automated systems — from industrial control systems and SCADA to software automation and robotic process automation. They optimize processes for reliability and efficiency.
